summary: Prudential plc, a UK/Hong Kong dual-listed life insurer, filed a Form 6-K reporting daily open-market repurchases of its own ordinary shares from JP Morgan Securities plc. Between 5 and 9 October 2026 it bought 3,989,800 shares on XLON at a volume-weighted average of roughly 9.04 GBP per share, with prices between 8.7340 and 9.2960 GBP. Shares will be cancelled, leaving 2,473,996,928 in issue. Since the 6 January 2026 and 2 September 2026 buyback programmes began, 79,950,041 shares have been repurchased. Watch execution pace against shareholder authority.
